name: ovb3
description: Read/write/search VBCS artifacts, audit cross-app service calls, commit/push/pull, run grunt-vb-build/grunt-vb-audit, trigger VB Studio CI jobs, and manage standalone VBCS data - all from Claude.

vbs_workspace_dir.title: VBS workspace directory
vbs_workspace_dir.description: A local folder that holds (or will hold) git checkouts of your VB Studio project repos. list_repos/list_apps discover what's under here. Created automatically on the first clone if it doesn't exist.

vbcs_repo_path.title: Default repo checkout (optional)
vbcs_repo_path.description: Absolute path to one repo checkout to use by default when a tool call doesn't specify one. Leave blank if you work across multiple repos.

vbcs_app_name.title: Default app name (optional)
vbcs_app_name.description: VBCS web app name (webApps/<name>) to use by default when a tool call doesn't specify one.

component_exchange_url.title: Component Exchange URL (optional)
component_exchange_url.description: Your org's Component Exchange URL, required by grunt-vb-build/grunt-vb-audit for apps using shared/custom components (the normal case). Leave blank if you don't know it yet - build/audit will surface Oracle's own clear error instead of guessing.

vbstudio_git_username.title: VB Studio git username (optional)
vbstudio_git_username.description: Username for HTTPS git access to your VB Studio repos. With the token below, clone/pull/push run without any interactive prompt.

vbstudio_git_token.title: VB Studio git token (optional)
vbstudio_git_token.description: A VB Studio personal access token. Stored in your system keychain, never written to URLs, logs or .git/config.

vbstudio_git_user_name.title: Commit author name (optional)
vbstudio_git_user_name.description: Name used on commits made through this plugin.

vbstudio_git_user_email.title: Commit author email (optional)
vbstudio_git_user_email.description: Email used on commits made through this plugin.

vbcs_base_url.title: Standalone VBCS base URL (optional)
vbcs_base_url.description: Bare host of a standalone VBCS instance, e.g. https://vbcs-<tenant>-<env>.builder.<region>.ocp.oraclecloud.com (no /ic/builder). Only for VBCS apps without a VB Studio project.

vbcs_idcs_username.title: Standalone VBCS username (optional)
vbcs_idcs_username.description: IDCS username for the standalone VBCS instance.

vbcs_idcs_password.title: Standalone VBCS password (optional)
vbcs_idcs_password.description: IDCS password for the standalone VBCS instance. Stored in your system keychain.

vbstudio_api_token.title: VB Studio API token (optional)
vbstudio_api_token.description: Personal access token used as a bearer token for the VB Studio CI REST API. If blank, the git token above is used as the bearer token.
